evidence.title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed

summary: OpenAI has unveiled an 'Ultrafast mode' for its GPT-5.6 Sol model, claiming up to 14 times faster performance. The feature aims to enhance efficiency for high-speed AI applications.
title: OpenAI Previews Ultrafast Mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, Promising 14X Speed Boost
